name: prefilter_image_logreg
status: research experiment: trained on image-derived features (rule B5), to be validated by the team before operational use
task: fast pre-filter for images, memes and video frames: P(sexual) as the AI judge (Qwen3.5-9B, frozen prompt v3) would decide; items under the threshold are not sent to the judge
contents: weights only: scaler mean/variance per dimension (1152 aggregate statistics), 1152 coefficients, 1 intercept; no image, no embedding of the training pool
threshold_rule: highest threshold keeping 95 % recall of the judge's positives on DEV (never on the benchmark)

training.pool: MemeLens memes (FHM, MMHS, MAMI), near-copies of the benchmark removed (pHash <= 8)

feed_10pct_prevalence.note: 459 extra negatives labelled by the judge, not checked by hand: estimate

limits: trained on memes: not evaluated on video frames
sees the image only: content carried by speech or text alone can be filtered out
benchmark recall on 60 positives only (95 % CI 0.886-0.991)
